source_matches.source_excerpt: Understand Python strings as sequences, including length calculation with len, traversal with loops, slicing, immutability, loop-based counting, membership with the in operator, string comparison, string methods, parsing strings, format operators, and debugging string-related code.

Understand file handling in Python, including persistence, opening files, working with text files and lines, reading files, searching through file contents, allowing users to choose file names, using try, except, and open for safer file access, writing files, and debugging file-processing code.
